answer: Sealed-replica storage costs each fake identity one 4 GB disk plus ~3 hours of sequential sealing. Every agent seals its own orchard of 65,536 leaves under its key and publishes the root as its jade commitment. Each epoch a verifier picks a random vertex of that tree and demands the leaf plus Merkle path within 2 seconds; a farm keeping one shared copy for 50 aliases must re-seal on demand and misses the deadline. Seals are key-bound and sequential, so they cannot be shared, parallelized across aliases or bought in bulk: 50 fakes mean 50 disks and 150 sealing hours.
